description_en: Queries the details of a specified configuration group

kebab_example: aliyun ecd describe-timer-group --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --group-id cg-hs3i1w39o68ma0000 --api-version 2020-09-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeTimerGroup

parameters.help_en: The region ID. This feature is not region-specific. Set this parameter to `cn-shanghai`
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。该功能无地域属性，该字段固定填写`cn-shanghai`
